newsitem.title: switzerland: Swiss franc ends off 2-year low vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc ends off 2-year low vs dollar.

text.p: 1605 GMT - The Swiss franc ended mixed as the dollar stayed high against European currencies, pushing down the Swiss unit in the wake of a weaker German mark.

But the dollar was unable to hold its highest point after reaching a two-year high of 1.3330 Swiss francs. * Dollar ends at 1.3300/3310 Swiss francs vs opening 1.3288/3298 and Monday's close of 1.3135/3145. * Mark closes at 84.96/99 centimes, barely up from opening 84.94/96 and below prior close of 85.13/16.

* One trader said the dollar showed signs of slipping and a technical correction was likely. If so, dollar/Swiss could be expected to head down to 1.3060 or 1.3070 before resuming a climb. * Dollar/Swiss was seen in a range of 1.3240 to 1.3330/3350. * Mark/Swiss range was set at 84.70/85.10 * Volatility was high, espcially in mark/Swiss, as liquidity thinned towards year-end, traders said. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
